collisionMethodLimits: Signed nearest-surface distances are diagnostic and do not certify complete strand radii or segment/body collision.
Mouth triangle self-overlaps exclude triangles sharing vertices and are limited to the perioral region.
Four recorded rig frames and neutral/open/smile do not cover walking, running, crouching, turning or all required expressions.
